_comment: Signed editorial entries. See docs/adr/ADR-002-editorial-voice.md and docs/automation/CRITIC.md. An entry without author, date and revision does not publish. Only the Classical Music Recording Critic (named editorial role) may author `text`, `stars`, `reference` or `matrix`. Other agents must not draft, complete or suggest those fields. Critic (or Developer shipping Critic content) lands the entry on main / Pages. Scout candidate pools (ADR-004) live in data/scout/ — they are not signed entries, must not appear in this schema, and never carry stars, reference, matrix or text.

entries.text: The entry. Comparative by reflex — Diapason never assessed a recording in isolation, and neither should this. Say what it does that the alternatives do not, and be willing to prefer.

consulted._comment: User-visible links consulted when writing the entry. Not ADR-003 quotes and not aggregate sources. Pages renders a References block under the signed prose, never inside the verdict paragraph. title, url and kind are required. kind is discography | review | label | reference | award. At most 8 items.
consulted.title: Source title

quotes._comment: ADR-003. Max 2 per entry, 25 words each, 20% of the source notice. The entry must argue with the quote, not display it — that part is your responsibility, not the validator's.

matrix._comment: Optional. Critic Morningstar axes only — never invent these in seed or statements. Card face maps the two integers onto a 5×5 style box (X = sound 1–5 left→right, Y = interpretation 1–5 bottom→top) with a caption Interpretation n · Sound m; overall is 0.6*interpretation + 0.4*sound at one decimal in the How scored expand, never stored, never on the card. Ledger is evidence, not a calculator: do not derive axis scores from it. Tier C alone cannot raise an axis (Critic rule; UI copy, not auto-computed). Sound band 5 is English Reference; Référence remains the signed editorial flag only.
